name: @octanejs/embla-carousel
description: Embla Carousel bindings for Octane, API-compatible with embla-carousel-react 8.6.0.

scripts.test: node audit/type-parity.mjs && vitest run --root ../.. --project embla-carousel --project embla-carousel-pristine-utils --project embla-carousel-differential --project embla-carousel-hydration --project embla-carousel-ssr --project embla-carousel-audit --project embla-carousel-browser
